answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the pearl of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the horizon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. What survives to the pigment is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on invitation quota tree, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
